text:
violet: saw an OOM on shard-prod-18 at 02:18 UTC. differs from prior incidents -- mid-size object residency rises following compact windows. heap summary: https://logs.company/oom/1799990001

omar: paste the head stats?

violet: short scrape:
heap.used_mb: 14800 -> 27200 over 5h
kv.residency.count: 1.0M -> 3.4M
kv.mid_bucket(256-1024B): 95k -> 740k
gc.pause.p95: 20ms -> 68ms

raj: looks like alloc churn + delayed frees. i'll own alloc tracing and survivor histograms in staging. due Tue EOD.

claire: i'll run a soft-evict canary at 70% on 3 nodes and add pre/post hot-key snapshot. will collect 72h metrics. due Fri.

omar: infra: autoscaler ignored it; propose an advisory rule based on residency delta. i'll prototype rule and test in staging. due Wed noon.

violet: list concise follow-ups for tracker (one-line each):

raj: Action: alloc tracing + survivor histograms -> owner: raj -> due: 2026-03-31 -> success: top 5 alloc sites & repro in staging

claire: Action: canary soft-evict 70% + hot-key snapshots -> owner: claire -> due: 2026-04-02 -> success: <3% errors and >=12% drop in peak residency

omar: Action: residency-delta autoscale advisory prototype -> owner: omar -> due: 2026-03-30 noon PST -> success: staging validates advisory for 2 synth runs

violet: Action: update postmortem tracker + schedule retro -> owner: violet -> due: 2026-03-29 -> success: tracker links + retro invite posted

ops-bot: Created issue INF-5077 - "Mid-size residency spike after compaction / followups" (https://jira.company/browse/INF-5077). Assigned: raj, claire, omar, violet.

raj: starting tracing now, will attach flamegraphs to INF-5077.

claire: canary config pushed to infra repo and calendar invite sent.

omar: drafting autoscale advisory and simulation plan.

violet: please paste PRs, dashboards, and experiment IDs into INF-5077. i'll post nightly summaries to #eng-oncall for 7 days.

ops-bot: Incident note appended to INF-5077: "New variant observed; follow-ups assigned; canary + tracing in progress."

violet: thanks all. reconvene at retro to pick long-term mitigations (allocator work, eviction heuristics, API rate guards).

raj: ack. will report findings Tue.

claire: will post canary dashboard after 24h.

omar: will validate advisory in staging by Wed noon.

violet: end.
